profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a Mountain View, California company that describes itself as an "agentic talent intelligence" platform aimed at HR leaders. Its core offering covers AI-assisted recruiting and talent management, including candidate screening, skills matching, and interview support. The company states that its AI agents conduct and summarize candidate interviews around the clock but characterizes the technology as advisory rather than decisional, noting that recruiters make the final calls. It reports that some customers have reduced time-to-fill by 33% and filled certain roles in as little as 1.3 days.

The tracked product, listed under HR and Talent AI, is the Eightfold AI platform, which the site associates with skills matching, DEI bias risk considerations, and high-stakes employment decisions. The company also describes what it calls the world's first AI management standard, under which it says its AI is built and monitored against an independently audited framework, with third-party auditors testing its AI Interviewer product for bias and publishing the results.

The site's held facts show a California legal-exposure count of 175 cases, which is notable given that the platform operates in employment contexts where state AI and hiring-bias regulations are active.
